title: Someone is using my identity: what you can do now
pageTitle: Someone is using my identity: what you can do now | Spamlock
description: Accounts, bills or letters you don’t recognise? Steps you can take now: write it down, contact the company, freeze your credit and report it.
answer: Write down what you found, then contact the company or bank involved. In the US you can freeze your credit for free and report it at IdentityTheft.gov.
stepsTitle: Steps you can take if someone is using your identity

steps.title: Write down what happened
steps.text: Dates, letters and accounts you don’t know. You’ll need these when you contact companies or report it.

steps.title: Contact the company or bank involved
steps.text: Use the number on its official website or on your card, and tell them about the account or payment you don’t recognise. They can close or stop it.

steps.title: Freeze your credit (US)
steps.text: Free in the US, at each of the 3 bureaus. It stops new accounts being opened in your name.

steps.title: Report it
steps.text: In the US, report it to the FTC and you get a free recovery plan. Elsewhere, report it to the police.

steps.title: Check your credit reports and statements
steps.text: Look for accounts or payments you didn’t make, and tell the company about any you find.

app.title: This guide is in the Spamlock app
app.text: Mark each step as done as you go.
